findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：Avnet（通路商）占營收23%（2024為22%），為最大單一收入對象；無直接OEM客戶超過10%。搜尋未見最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的來源。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR NXP 10-K FY2025 (via search summary)
findings.excerpt: Avnet accounted for 23% of our revenue in 2025 and 22% in 2024.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：無其他通路商占營收超過10%；前五大通路商為 Arrow、Avnet、Nexty、WT Micro、World Peace。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR NXP 10-K FY2025 (via search summary)
findings.excerpt: Arrow, Avnet, Nexty, WT Micro and World Peace. No other distributor accounted for greater than 10% of our revenue.

note: 查無最大終端客戶導入第二供應商或 in-house 的來源；僅有客戶集中度事實。
